svg.title: Same first three layers. A difference in the fourth.
svg.desc: The cube and the eight-vertex Möbius ladder each have eight vertices, twelve edges and degree three. Their ordinary height series agree through volume three and first differ at volume four by two q to the fourth times one minus q squared to the fourth.
svg.text: S I N G U L A R I T Y
A provable difference in the fourth.
At q = ½, the exact gap is 81/2048.
